Lina K.: Hey — spotted two charges on the corp card from my Singapore trip: 'BAGGAGE FEE 2PC' SGD 45 and 'HOTEL MINIBAR' SGD 12. I paid the baggage at airline kiosk because it wouldn't take my personal card. The minibar was accidental. How should I get the minibar reimbursed (or pay it back)? Can finance split the card charge?
Zach R.: @Lina K. yeah pls file the baggage as biz and the minibar as personal. tag me if you need approval for the reimburse flow. :+1:
expense-bot: To split a corporate-card transaction, submit an expense with two line items and attach receipts. Example command:```/expenses submit --card-split
line1: 45 SGD -> business, attach airline_receipt.pdf
line2: 12 SGD -> personal, attach minibar_photo.jpg
notes: "SG trip 2025 - baggage + accidental minibar"```
Janelle (Finance): @Lina K. thanks for flagging. We can reimburse the baggage fee (business) back to the corp-card ledger and mark the minibar as employee-paid. We need: 1) itemized receipt from the airline showing the SGD 45 baggage fee; 2) minibar receipt/photo for the SGD 12. Also, confirm the bank conversion used (card statement shows USD amounts?). If you want us to bill the personal amount back to you, we can create a personal-charge request once you submit the split expense.
Lina K.: Uploading receipts now: airline_receipt.pdf -> https://redwood-files/receipts/airline_1746200000.pdf ; minibar_photo.jpg -> https://redwood-files/receipts/minibar_1746200000.jpg
Lina K.: The card statement shows the baggage as $33.10 and minibar as $8.82 (bank did SGD->USD on 2025-06-12). There is a tiny FX loss vs the SGD posted amounts — about $0.50 on the baggage line. Any chance finance can absorb the rounding loss?
Janelle (Finance): If the corp card was used for a legitimate business charge (baggage) we reimburse using the card-statement USD amount. We do not require employees to cover mill rounding differences for business charges under $5 — so finance will absorb the ~$0.50. For the minibar (personal), please create the personal charge line in the submission so payroll can collect the $8.82 from you (or we can invoice you).
Lina K.: Perfect, thanks. I'll submit the split now and tag @Zach R. for approval.
corp-card-bot: Card transaction matched to receipt(s). Status: needs-approval -> /expenses view 1746200000
Janelle (Finance): Once submitted, I'll route the personal-charge to payroll and confirm when the baggage reimbursement posts to the card ledger. Ping me if anything goes sideways. :money_with_wings:
Zach R.: Approved for business baggage. :white_check_mark:
Lina K.: Submitted and tagged you both. Thanks! :pray:
